_note: Reviewer-owned standard exam (F3). Run after all corpus steps are scanned and every non-decision candidate is approved through the normal review flow. Ask each question in a fresh assistant session. Checks are applied to the assistant answer text plus the source references the API returns with it.

check_semantics.must_include: every string appears in the answer text
check_semantics.must_include_any: at least one string appears in the answer text
check_semantics.must_not_include: none of the strings appears in the answer text
check_semantics.cite_file: the answer's returned source references include this file name
check_semantics.must_not_cite_file: the answer's returned source references do not include this file name
check_semantics.conflict_notice: answer includes both conflicting values and one of 冲突/不一致/矛盾
check_semantics.suggestion_label: answer contains a section explicitly labelled as 建议, and is not a refusal (no ANSWER_NOT_VERIFIED / 无法回答)
check_semantics.insufficient: answer states the evidence is insufficient (依据不足/没有找到/资料中没有/未提及) and the question is recorded in the knowledge-gap list
